name: tdc-late-counterpart-after-deadline
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "healthy.va"
ahdl_include "dut.va"
VR(ref 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 165.48n 0 165.5n 0.9 167.5n 0.9 167.52n 0 220n 0]
VF(fb 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 210.68n 0 210.7n 0.9 212.7n 0.9 212.72n 0 220n 0]
Vreset(rst 0) vsource dc=0
X(ref fb rst code valid) fine_tdc
tran tran stop=220n maxstep=20p errpreset=conservative
save ref fb rst code valid

name: healthy-fine-actuator
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "healthy.va"
ahdl_include "dut.va"
VC(coarse 0) vsource dc=10
VF(fine 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 2u 0 2.001u 1 4u 1 4.001u -1 6u -1]
VR(rst 0) vsource dc=0
VE(en 0) vsource dc=0.9
X(coarse fine rst en dco) healthy_dco
Vref(ref 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=100n width=40n rise=20p fall=20p
VD(fb 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=100n width=40n rise=20p fall=20p
tran tran stop=6u maxstep=250p errpreset=conservative
save dco ref fb fine coarse
